name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, with selectable trees, flowers, grass and animated water. Complete Pallet, Viridian, Route 1, Viridian Forest, Gen 1 caves, New Bark, Cherrygrove, Violet, Azalea, Mahogany, Cianwood, Olivine, Ecruteak, Blackthorn, Goldenrod, Lake of Rage and Mt. Silver Outside backgrounds. Johto Routes 29-46 are complete. Gen 2 Pokemon Centers offer Compact and redesigned Expanded versions. Pallet houses/lab and Gen 2 Marts have native-scale roof overhangs. Ilex Forest, Ruins of Alph Outside and both National Park variants are complete. Other maps remain in progress.
